# Recurrence - last 30 days

One row per **runtime unit**: a Kubernetes workload (`k8s · namespace/workload`), otherwise a process group (`process · …`), otherwise a host. Problems raised on a service are counted on the unit the service runs in. Days are UTC. Every tile reads a fixed 30-day window, independent of the dashboard timeframe.

1.title: Davis problems per runtime unit per day (top 25)

2.title: OOM kills per workload per day
2.query:
// Recurrence: OOM kills per Kubernetes workload per day (matches the OOMKilled events on isb54165).
timeseries oom = sum(dt.kubernetes.container.oom_kills, default: 0), by: { k8s.namespace.name, k8s.workload.name }, from: now()-30d, interval: 1d
| fieldsAdd unit = concat("k8s · ", k8s.namespace.name, "/", k8s.workload.name), total = arraySum(oom)
| filter total > 0
| sort total desc
| limit 25
| fields timeframe, interval, unit, oom

3.title: Process crashes per process group per day (excl. short-lived / Linux System)

4.title: Most recurrent runtime units
